## Checklist

- [ ] `dart run tests/run.dart` ends with "everything passes"

- [ ] Scripts still use only `dart:io` — no packages, no network, no new external commands
- [ ] Store rules, dates and API levels link to the official Apple / Google page (below)
- [ ] Nothing here is specific to one coding agent
